title: 第22章 打脸第23章 武道会
lines: “万大哥，那这演武场若是让一些资历不足的弟子随意闯入的话，那对于我们这些辛苦修炼的弟子而言岂不是很不公平！”
这时，一个少年突然开口言道。
而其余江家子弟也都是附和的点了点头。
那被称为万兄的青年名为江万，在内府弟子中也算有些威望，如今实力也是达到了开脉境的八重巅峰，他当即大笑了起来。
“哈哈哈！这个你们不用担心。”
“我们内府的演武场设置有一个防御阵法，那个阵法是由我们内府八大弟子共同铸造而成，其中融合了我们八大弟子无数的智慧。
在这内府之中至今为止还没有人能够破解得了！”
那些江家子弟闻言，一个个脸上一阵亢奋，真不愧是他们内府最厉害的八大弟子，果然名不虚传，铸就的大阵如今都没有一人能破吗？
真厉害啊！感受到周围一道道火热的目光，江万脸上的神色更加的得意了起来。
虽然他江万并非是内府的八大弟子，但谁都知道他和八大弟子关系匪浅，所以此刻他也感觉到虚荣感爆棚。
他轻咳了一声，继续说道：“不过，你们也不必担心，我江万便是镇守这演武场之人，所以我想只要不是个笨蛋，就不会随意来到这演武场上撒野。”
“万大哥，这么说你的实力岂不是很厉害！”
又有弟子提问道。
“那是自然！如今我的实力在开脉境八重巅峰，而且就算是普通的开脉境九重如今我也能轻易胜之。
若是有机会，也可以给你们显示一番。”
众人闻言，面色更是涨红了几分。
有人过来啦！”
忽然，一名少年惊咦一声。
随后所有的人立即齐齐的望向了少年目光汇聚之处，只见那里一名身着白衣的少年正缓步走向了这边。
“这里的灵气好浓郁啊！不过这里到底是哪？”
这白衣少年自然就是江玄，他一路寻找藏书阁不知不觉竟来到了这里！“你是什么人？
竟然闯入了这里？”
江万面色有些冰冷，目光凝视着江玄。
听到声音，江玄这才发现了不远的江万等人，顿时察觉了异样，他歉意的抱了抱拳。
“兄台，在下一不小心迷了路，误入了此地，还望见谅！”
说完，江玄就准备离开。
“小子！你站住！”
然而，就在江玄正要打算离开的时候，在他身后一道冰冷的声音顿时响了起来。
“有事？”
江玄问道。
“小子，按照规定，误入这演武场的弟子需要缴纳十两银子作为惩罚，我念你是初犯，所以你只需要缴纳九两便可离开。
否则”江万双手环胸，笑眯眯的道。
content_en:
"Brother Wan, if some underqualified disciples are allowed to break into this martial arts arena at will, wouldn't it be very unfair to us disciples who have worked hard to cultivate!"
At this time, a young man suddenly spoke.
The other Jiang family members also nodded in agreement.
The young man who was called Brother Wan was named Jiang Wan. He was somewhat prestigious among the inner disciples. His strength had now reached the peak of the eighth level of the Pulse Opening Realm. He immediately burst into laughter.
"Hahaha! You don't have to worry about this."
"There is a defensive formation in the martial arts field of our inner palace. That formation was jointly forged by the eight disciples of our inner palace, and it incorporated the countless wisdom of our eight major disciples.
No one in this inner palace has been able to crack it so far! "
When the Jiang family disciples heard this, their faces were filled with excitement. They were truly the eight most powerful disciples in their inner dynasty. Their reputation was well-deserved. No one could break the formation they had created, right?
How awesome! Feeling the fiery gazes around him, the look on Jiang Wan's face became even more proud.
Although he, Jiang Wan, is not the eighth disciple of the inner palace, everyone knows that he has a close relationship with the eighth disciple, so at this moment he also feels a sense of vanity.
He coughed lightly and continued: "However, you don't have to worry. I, Jiang Wan, am the one guarding this martial arts arena, so I think as long as I am not a fool, I will not randomly come to this martial arts arena to act wild."
"Brother Wan, wouldn't it say that your strength is very powerful!"
Another disciple asked.
"That's natural! My strength is now at the peak of the eighth level of the Pulse Opening Realm, and I can easily defeat even the ordinary ninth level of the Pulse Opening Realm.
If I have the chance, I can show it to you. "
When everyone heard this, their faces turned even redder.
"Eh?
Someone is coming! "
Suddenly, a young man screamed in surprise.
Then everyone immediately looked at the place where the young man's eyes were converging, and saw a young man in white walking slowly towards this side.
"The spiritual energy here is so rich! But where is this place?"
This young man in white is naturally Jiang Xuan. He searched for the library and ended up here unknowingly! "Who are you?
You actually broke into this place? "
Jiang Wan's face looked a little cold and he stared at Jiang Xuan.
Hearing the sound, Jiang Xuan noticed Jiang Wan and others not far away, and immediately noticed something strange. He hugged his fists apologetically.
"Brother, I accidentally lost my way and ended up here by mistake. Please forgive me!"
After saying that, Jiang Xuan was ready to leave.
"Boy! Stop!"
However, just when Jiang Xuan was about to leave, a cold voice suddenly sounded behind him.
"Is something wrong?"
Jiang Xuan asked.
"Boy, according to the regulations, disciples who accidentally enter this martial arts arena need to pay ten taels of silver as punishment. I think you are a first offender, so you only need to pay nine taels before leaving.
Otherwise," Jiang Wan crossed his arms and said with a smile.
